name: Hide ads
description: Removes in-chat banner ads, explore ads, and call-end promotional cards.

name: Ghost mode
description: Prevents sending read receipts (seen status) and typing indicators.

name: Anti-delete messages
description: Retains messages even when deleted or retracted by the sender.

name: Clean UI
description: Removes the Explore tab and promotional badges from bottom navigation.

name: Secondary device mode
description: Enables using Viber on 2 mobile phones simultaneously via QR companion linking without deactivating the primary phone.
